title: Ayushmann Khurrana breaks silence on Jude Anthany Joseph’s Mohanlal comment: “I hope I’m worthy enough to share screen space with him someday”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Jude had put up a post after meeting Ayushmann, writing, “Wonderful catching up with Ayushmann today ❤️ Just to clarify, my Mohanlal Sir comment was about the producer and had nothing to do with him. Nothing but respect between us. Hope we get to work together soon! ❤️ He was so happy with the Mohanlal sir script, and unfortunately it didn’t work out. It was definitely not his fault that it didn’t happen. Hope we get to work together someday.”

Adding to this, Responding to Jude’s post, Ayushmann wrote, “I’m a fan of your work and I hope that I get the opportunity to work with you soon. I have the utmost respect for Mohanlal sir’s work. He is a legend. I hope I’m worthy enough to share screen space with him someday.”

Meanwhile, The exchange comes amid discussions surrounding comments attributed to Jude about a project that was as per reports being developed with Ayushmann. However, there appears to have been no direct communication between Ayushmann or his management and Jude Anthany Joseph regarding the project. Any discussions, if they took place at the production level, were understood to have been at a preliminary stage, before any formal commitment from the star.

Notably, Importantly, Mohanlal’s name had not been part of any project-related discussion involving Ayushmann or his team. The star’s latest comment, therefore, makes his position clear: he holds the Malayalam superstar in the highest regard and would welcome the opportunity to work with him in the future.

As per the latest buzz, For now, Ayushmann’s response also puts to rest any suggestion of friction between him and Jude. The star’s warm message and the filmmaker’s clarification indicate that there is nothing but mutual respect between the two, with both expressing a desire to collaborate in the future.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In further updates, Noorani's police custody is scheduled to continue until August 12, following which he is expected to be produced before the court again. title: X replaces ‘misaligned’ revenue sharing program with Original Content Rewards
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

X replaces ‘misaligned’ revenue sharing program with Original Content Rewards Anthony Ha 9:34 AM PDT · August 8, 2026 X, the social media platform now owned by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, is shaking up how it pays influencers and creators.

Adding to this, In announcing the change , the company shared it will be winding down its existing Revenue Sharing program and replacing it with something called Original Content Rewards. X will stop accepting new Revenue Sharing participants, while existing participants will continue earning money through September 7.

Meanwhile, What counts as original content? X shared it can include original reporting and analysis, photos and videos created by the poster, or memes and graphics they’ve designed themselves. Commentary also counts, but “if your content regularly incorporates material created by others, you’ll need to contribute meaningful original value for it to qualify under our original content guidelines.”

Notably, The company also included examples of posts that won’t count as original, such as those just copied over from another account, downloaded from one account and re-uploaded to your own, or reposting content “without meaningful transformation.”

As per the latest buzz, This announcement follows repeated attempts by X to reform the Revenue Sharing program, for example by reducing payments to aggregators and “clickbait” accounts in April . But these efforts have also prompted complaints from popular accounts profiting from the current system; Musk even reversed some of those changes (giving a creator’s local audience more weight when calculating payouts) after a backlash.
In further updates, In a post about the new changes , X’s Allegra Jacchia wrote that the existing program “had reached a point where its incentives were misaligned.”

On top of that, “Creators should be focused on bringing net new content to the platform instead of maximizing payouts,” she shared. “We could have kept adding more rules and exceptions, but ultimately the better decision was to start fresh and build a program designed from day one to reward originality.”
Jacchia added that X be “continue refining the program, improving our models, and raising the bar over time.”

title: Trouble in CINTAA: 8 members resign amid allegations against Poonam Dhillon, Padmini Kolhapure, reveals Upasana Singh
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Eight elected members of the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA) Executive Committee have resigned from their posts as well as from the committee with immediate effect, citing a loss of confidence in the association's current functioning. The members have also called for fresh elections.

Adding to this, In a joint letter, the members listed alleged repeated instances of the association moving away from collective decision-making, consultation and constitutional governance. They alleged that decision-making had increasingly come into the hands of CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior Vice President Padmini Kolhapure , along with some other members of the Executive Committee.

Meanwhile, One of the key allegations in the letter concerns the manner in which official communication and representation on behalf of CINTAA were being handled. The members alleged that Dhillon had taken several decisions independently, including communicating with government officials through her ID and deciding on communications with industry bodies through the association's official ID.

Notably, The members also raised questions over the alleged involvement of lawyers in meetings with government officials. They claimed that Dhillon and Kolhapure had visited government offices accompanied by privately engaged lawyers who were introduced as CINTAA lawyers, despite allegedly having no authorisation or sanction from the Executive Committee.

As per the latest buzz, Confirming the resignations to ANI, Singh shared 11 members in total had stepped down, eight of whom were elected members of the Executive Committee. She shared the eight elected members had submitted both their resignations and complaints detailing their concerns.

In further updates, "Out of our 11 members, eight elected members have resigned and submitted their resignations to me. They have also submitted their complaints, stating that Padmini Kolhapure and Poonam Dhillon are misusing their positions," Singh shared.

On top of that, Singh also questioned the use of personal email accounts for official CINTAA correspondence. She shared communications on behalf of an association should ordinarily be routed through its official email system, allowing the organisation to maintain transparency and retain a record of its correspondence that can be accessed by the association.

title: Guru Randhawa asks trolls to 'calm down' amid Fine Shyt backlash: 'Silly little slang'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In the last few days, singer Guru Randhawa has faced a lot of trolling and backlash after he rolled out his song Fine Shyt on Thursday. Many on social media called out the song for being misogynistic towards female corporate workers and also called it a cringe fest. Now, Randhawa has addressed the backlash and called it “a silly little slang”.

Adding to this, Guru Randhawa in the music video of Fine Shyt. 'Guilty as charged' The singer remains unfazed by the row and shared a video of himself driving a Porsche on an empty road in a desert. Taking to his Instagram handle, Guru wrote, “Guilty as charged of making songs that repeat in your head forever. Low-key loving the edits though. No bad vibes! It’s just a silly little slang… calm down calm down calm down fam."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Guru Randhawa (@gururandhawa)

Notably, Before addressing the backlash, Randhawa reflected on the incident as he visited the Golden Temple in Amritsar. On Sunday, the singer had shared a photo of himself while sitting near the holy Amrit Sarovar. While he did not address the backlash directly, he shared a message talking about faith and continuing to move ahead despite difficult times.

As per the latest buzz, He wrote in the caption in Punjabi, which roughly translates to, "Whom Waheguru blesses, no storm can ever shake. When Baba Nanak holds someone’s hand, they only keep moving forward."

In further updates, The Fine Shyt music video began with a disclaimer stating that all the people in the video are above 18 and that it is a work of fiction. It is set in an office, with Guru playing a senior professional, while he is surrounded by young talent, especially female colleagues. It shows Guru concentrating on work while the female colleagues dance and sing around him. The song rubbed some viewers the wrong way, and many called the singer out for allegedly sexualising workspaces and questioned the overall treatment of the women featured in the video.
On top of that, This isn't the first time Guru Randhawa's music has faced backlash. Earlier, his song Azul was also criticised for allegedly sexualising schoolgirls.

Meanwhile, Tony Kakkar also took a playful jibe at Guru. He shared a video in which he pretended to be on a phone call with the singer. He joked about the row and shared, "Yes, Guru bhai! What have you done, yaar? You did it all by yourself and didn't even tell me. Would I have picked up your call? No, no, I don't answer anyone's calls, but I would definitely have picked up yours."

title: 'Na maine chumma diya, na liya': Kumar Sanu takes cheeky dig at Udit Narayan over kiss controversy
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kumar Sanu and Udit Narayan were among the top singers of the 90s era. The singers competed for some of the best songs of that time, but as the years passed, they also developed a friendship. However, this didn't stop Kumar from taking a playful jibe at Udit during a recent interaction.

Adding to this, Kumar Sanu took a jibe at Udit Narayan. Kumar Sanu takes a jibe at Udit While in conversation with The Lallantop, Kumar was asked about his massive fan following, with many girls being followers of his songs. Kumar took this opportunity to take a jibe at Udit over the widely shared concert video in which he was seen kissing female followers.

Meanwhile, The Aashiqui singer shared, “Nahi mereko ko koi chumma wumma nahi khaya. Na maine kisi ko khaya. Na toh me chumma dia, na liya. Maine woh sab nahi kiya (No, nobody came and kissed me. Nor did I kiss anyone. I neither gave nor received a kiss. I didn’t do any of that)."

Notably, During the same interaction, Kumar spoke about his friendship with Udit. While he admitted that they would compete with each other back in the day, but now they share a good equation because they have nothing to lose.

As per the latest buzz, In 2025, videos from Udit Narayan's live performance went widely shared, showing him kissing his female followers as they came to click selfies with him during the performance. One moment drew the strongest reaction when a female fan leaned towards Udit, wanting to kiss him on the cheek, and the singer turned his face and their lips touched. The video went widely shared, and the singer faced backlash, with many raising concerns about consent.

In further updates, This led to more clips of Udit being unearthed, which showed him interacting and getting close to female singers and followers. The singer later addressed the backlash and defended his actions.

On top of that, Udit spoke to HT City and shared, “Followers itne deewane hote hain na. Hum log aise nahi hain, hum decent log hain (Followers are crazy. We are not like that, we are decent people). Some people encourage this and show their love through this. Udaake kya karna hai ab iss cheez ko? (No need to publicise this more). There are so many people in the crowd, and we have bodyguards present too. But followers think they are getting a chance to meet, so someone extends their hands for a handshake, some kiss the hands... yeh sab deewangi hoti hai. Uspe itna dhyaan nahi dena chahiye (This is just love of followers, no need to pay attention to it).”

title: Delhivery posts Rs 2,931 Cr revenue in Q1 FY27; profit declines 65%
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
New Update Logistics company Delhivery reported a 27.8% year-on-year increase in revenue in Q1 FY27, while its profit declined sharply during the quarter.

Adding to this, Delhivery's revenue from operations grew to Rs 2,931 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 2,294 crore rupees in Q1 FY26, according to its financial statements filed with the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

Meanwhile, The company primarily earns revenue from its logistics services, including warehousing, last-mile delivery, and the design and deployment of logistics management systems. Other income declined 12.3% to Rs 114 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 130 crore rupees in the year-ago quarter. As a result, the company's total income rose 25.6% to Rs 3,045 crore rupees from Rs 2,424 crore rupees in Q1 FY26.

Notably, Freight handling and servicing costs remained Delhivery's largest expense, accounting for 71.45% of total expenses. The cost increased 31.4% to Rs 2,152 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 1,638 crore rupees in the year-ago quarter.

As per the latest buzz, Employee benefit expenses increased 21.9% to Rs 429 crore rupees from Rs 352 crore rupees, while depreciation rose 28.6% to Rs 189 crore rupees from Rs 147 crore rupees. Finance costs remained flat at Rs 34 crore rupees, whereas other expenses climbed 33.5% to Rs 207 crore rupees from Rs 155 crore rupees.
In further updates, The company's total expenses rose 29.4% to Rs 3,012 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 2,327 crore rupees in Q1 FY26.

On top of that, Despite the strong growth in revenue, Delhivery's profit declined 64.8% to Rs 32 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 91 crore rupees in Q1 FY26. On a sequential basis, Delhivery's operating revenue increased 2.8% to Rs 2,930.73 crore rupees in Q1 FY27 from Rs 2,850 crore rupees in the preceding quarter, while its profit declined 55.9% to Rs 31.91 crore rupees from Rs 72.40 crore rupees during the same period.

title: Stock Market Today Highlights: BSE Sensex sheds over 450 points, Nifty50 closes below 24,600 as crude prices continue to rise
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Indian equity markets are expected to open on a mildly negative note, with Gift Nifty trading around 24,662, down by 86 points, indicating weak opening cues for domestic indices. Global markets are trading mixed as investors remain cautious ahead of key U.S. economic data and continue to assess the implications of recent trade-related developments. Meanwhile, crude oil prices have edged higher amid persistent geopolitical tensions, which may keep market sentiment subdued and lead to a cautious start for domestic equities.

Adding to this, Rupee weakened against the US dollar in the previous session, depreciating 16 paise to settle at 95.24. The currency came under pressure due to a slight recovery in the US Dollar Index, modest gains in US Treasury yields and continued foreign fund outflows. During the day, the rupee opened at 95.13 and traded in a range of 95.12 to 95.24 before ending at its weakest level of the session.

Meanwhile, Forex traders shared softer crude oil prices limited the downside for rupee by easing concerns around India's import bill. According to Mirae Asset ShareKhan analyst Anuj Choudhary, expectations of a possible US-Iran agreement could support rupee, although any rebound in the dollar index or Treasury yields may restrict gains.

Notably, According to analysts domestic equities have found support from multiple macroeconomic developments during the previous session. Vinod Nair, head of research at Geojit Investments, shared crude oil prices and intensified diplomatic efforts to restore stability in the Middle East improved investor confidence.

As per the latest buzz, He added that the Reserve Bank of India's decision to maintain the repo rate at 5.25% for the fourth consecutive meeting, along with its neutral policy stance and constructive economic outlook, encouraged selective buying in banking and energy stocks. The central bank also marginally raised its GDP growth forecast for the current financial year to 6.7% while trimming its inflation projection to 5%. However, policymakers maintained that future rate decisions would remain dependent on incoming economic data and inflation trends.

In further updates, Benchmark equity indices ended on a mixed note in the previous trading session, with BSE Sensex outperforming NSE Nifty as buying in heavyweight stocks offset broader caution. The 30-share Sensex climbed 373.76 points, or 0.48%, to settle at 78,954.76 after remaining in positive territory throughout the day. Meanwhile, Nifty 50 traded in a narrow range and edged up just 11.35 points, or 0.05%, to close at 24,636.

On top of that, During the session, the index touched an intraday high of 24,677.05 and a low of 24,604.15. Market sentiment was supported by moderation in crude oil prices, optimism surrounding diplomatic efforts in the Middle East and buying in heavyweight stocks such as Reliance Industries and ICICI Bank, even as broader gains remained limited.

title: Jude Anthany Joseph clarifies Mohanlal ‘secondary artist’ remark, says Ayushmann Khurrana ‘not at fault’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Malayalam filmmaker Jude Anthany Joseph of late stirred up row after he shared that he left a Bollywood movie starring Ayushmann Khurrana midway through discussions after he felt disrespected when Mohanlal was called a 'secondary artist'. Now, the filmmaker has shared a photo with Ayushmann and clarified that the remark was not made by the star.

Adding to this, Jude Anthany Joseph shared a photo with Ayushmann Khurrana. 'The comment had nothing to do with Ayushmann' Jude shared a photo with Ayushmann and showered him with love and lauded his talent. He also issued a clarification, stating that the problematic remark about superstar Mohanlal was made by a producer and not the Dum Laga Ke Haisha star. He wrote in the caption, “Wonderful catching up with Ayushmann today ❤️ Just to clarify, my Mohanlal Sir comment was about the producer and had nothing to do with him. Nothing but respect between us. Hope we get to work together soon! ❤️”

Meanwhile, In the caption, Jude also mentioned that Ayushmann was excited about the project, but it got shelved. He wrote, “He was so happy with the Mohanlal sir script, and unfortunately it didn’t work out. It was definitely not his fault that it didn’t happen. But I’m genuinely happy that I got to meet an star with so much talent and calibre. Hope we get to work together someday. ❤️”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jude Anthany Joseph (@judeanthanyjoseph)

As per the latest buzz, Ayushmann responded to Jude's post with an equally heartwarming message. He wrote, “I’m a fan of your work and I hope that I get the opportunity to work with you soon. I have the utmost respect for Mohanlal sir’s work. He is a legend. I hope I’m worthy enough to share screen space with him someday. 🙏🏽”

In further updates, During a recent interaction with Club FM, Jude shared that he chose to walk out of a project with Ayushmann Khurrana as the lead after his demand to confirm Mohanlal's role in the movie was taken lightly. The Malayalam superstar was also referred to as a ‘secondary artist’, which the director found insulting.

On top of that, He shared, “The basic script was almost complete. We had also discussed the story with the production house. At that time, Lal sir had a role in the story. It was an important role. However, they asked me to complete the screenplay first. At that point, I put forward a demand to them. I told them that I could complete the script, but my condition was that Lal sir should be verified for the project. They responded by saying, ‘First, we need to like the script. Only then will we think about the secondary artists.’”

Jude's latest clarification makes it clear that his disagreement was with the production house and not Ayushmann. His post also highlighted the mutual respect between the filmmaker and star, with both expressing hope that they can collaborate on a project in the future.

title: Filmmaker Shakeel Noorani held after aspiring actor alleges rape
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Mumbai, Mumbai Police have arrested Bollywood filmmaker Shakeel Noorani after a 33-year-old aspiring star accused him of raping and threatening her, officials shared on Monday.

Adding to this, Filmmaker Shakeel Noorani held after aspiring star alleges rape The 73-year-old accused was traced to his farmhouse in Mahabaleshwar hill station, located more than 200 km from Mumbai, on Saturday after he went into hiding following the registration of a First Information Report against him, they shared.
Meanwhile, Noorani is known for directing films like "Joru Ka Ghulam" , starring Govinda, and "Bade Dilwala" , which featured Suniel Shetty.
Notably, In her complaint, the woman alleged that Noorani sexually assaulted her over the last four years and also poisoned her, leading to a miscarriage.

As per the latest buzz, She claimed the accused had called her to his residence in the Malvani area here on the pretext of discussing the script of an soon-to-release movie project, where he allegedly spiked her drink and sexually assaulted her.

In further updates, When she regained consciousness, Noorani showed her an intimate video on his mobile phone and allegedly threatened to circulate it if she approached the police or informed her family.

On top of that, The accused subsequently used the purported video to allegedly threaten her and sexually assault her on multiple occasions. He also gave her contraceptive pills following the assault and poisoned her, causing a miscarriage, a police official shared quoting the woman's complaint lodged 40 days ago.
After the case was registered, the accused went into hiding. The police even searched his son's house at Lokhandwala in Mumbai's Andheri area, but could not trace him.

title: ‘She hurls abuses and I take it’: Govinda on Sunita Ahuja’s cheating claims, asks why bad-mouths him for success
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sunita Ahuja has often publicly spoken about Bollywood star Govinda's alleged extramarital affairs and infidelity with his co-stars. In a recent interaction, Govinda addressed those allegations and refused such claims, while also questioning Sunita for bad mouthing him to gain success.

Adding to this, Sunita Ahuja and Govinda have been married since 1987. 'She hurls abuses and I take it' In conversation with ANI, Govinda admitted that though Sunita had made such claims in the past, she is responsible for bringing up the kids in his household. He shared, "Itne pyaar se gali deti hai mujhe aur main khata bhi hoon unke haath se (She affectionately hurls abuses at me, and I just take it in stride). I feel that wherever people are and whatever roles the Almighty has assigned them—the specific niche they occupy—we wouldn't have achieved success without them being there. We simply wouldn't be who we are. She has a rightful claim over the many children in our family who have now grown up. She was also kind to them.”

Meanwhile, Govinda hinted at how Sunita has gained attention after she started speaking about him in public. He shared, "There are many things that remain unexpressed—things that can never be put into words. If I were to offer just a glimpse of these matters from the outside, would there really be a need to cast aspersions to create a distance? People often view that as an escape. Is it essential to say bad mouth your own people to gain success? That is a bit easy. Sunita does it tactfully. She offers four words of praise or perhaps the praise comes naturally and then voice a criticism. I see more love in that."

Notably, Sunita was a contestant on the of late concluded show Lock Upp 2. During her brief stint on the show, Sunita spoke about Govinda's alleged affairs. She shared, “In love, you should be able to tolerate everything. Chi Chi had so many affairs in his life; well, heroes and heroines do have such things. I think that after standing by Chi Chi for so many years, I deserve to have a son like him.”

As per the latest buzz, Govinda and Sunita Ahuja got married in 1987 in a private ceremony. At the time, he was already a Bollywood star. They kept their marriage under wraps for nearly two years for the sake of his career and made it public after the birth of their daughter, Tina Ahuja. Later, they had their son, Yashvardhan Ahuja.

In further updates, Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows. A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today. At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through movie reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, star interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing. Now, as Assistant Editor at Hindustan Times Entertainment, Vibha continues to chronicle the world of movies and pop culture. title: Amruta Khanvilkar issues legal warning over reports of separation from Himanshu Malhotra: ‘Baseless and defamatory’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Amruta Khanvilkar has taken a stand against media reports pertaining to her marriage with star Himanshu Malhotra , issuing a legal notice that warns the media and all social networking sites against indulging in the circulation of defamatory information regarding their personal life. Their lawyers issued a strongly worded notice, making it clear that any unverified claims or invasion of privacy could invite legal action. This notice was issued soon after reports were rolled out stating that Amruta and Himanshu have been living apart from each other for the last 18 months.

Adding to this, Amruta Khanvilkar issues legal notice over marriage reports with Himanshu Malhotra, warns against defamatory claims. Amruta Khanvilkar's legal team issues warning In a statement dated August 10, 2026, Amruta's legal representatives addressed the reports in a strong statement which read, “ It has come to our attention that certain online, social media and digital platforms are circulating content concerning Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar and her personal life, which is baseless, defamatory and/or in violation of her privacy.”

Meanwhile, The legal team acknowledged the importance of freedom of expression but drew a line at what it described as defamatory or misleading reporting. It added, “While the right to freedom of expression is respected, any misuse of such freedom to publish, circulate or share defamatory statements, rumours, unverified allegations or misleading information concerning Ms. Amruta Khanvilkar will be taken seriously.”

Notably, The statement also warned that those found responsible could face legal consequences. It shared, “ Wherever supported by available evidence, appropriate legal action will be initiated against the individuals, entities or organisations responsible for creating, publishing, circulating or sharing such content, in accordance with applicable law.”

As per the latest buzz, Her team further shared that instances of such content are being tracked and recorded for possible legal action, concluding, “All such instances are being monitored and documented for appropriate legal recourse.”

In further updates, View this post on Instagram Reports claim they have been living separately The legal notice follows a Times of India report stating that Amruta and Himanshu maintained separate addresses for the past 18 months. However, an insider verified that neither a divorce nor a legal separation is currently in the works. Despite living apart, the couple remained on excellent terms. The report also noted that they are still close friends who regularly catch up on both personal and professional matters.

On top of that, Rather than a dramatic falling out, the choice to move into different homes was as per reports a practical one. The report chalked the decision up to a mix of financial realities, shifting career priorities, and family obligations that made living together difficult at this stage. It also shared that the two of them were simply taking some space to evaluate their future.

It was on the sets of India's Best Cinestars Ki Khoj in 2004 where Amruta Khanvilkar and Himanshu Malhotra first met. They fell in love and after many years of being together, they got married in January 2015. That same year, Amruta and Himanshu participated in Nach Baliye 7 and ended up winning the dance reality show.

title: Pankaj Tripathi says Mirzapur was a 'leave me alone’ watch on OTT, will enter 'party mode’ in theatres | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

It has rarely happened in Indian cinema that something that began on streaming translates into a wide theatrical rollout. But such is the craze for Mirzapur that after three seasons, the popular show is finishing its journey with a theatrical spinoff. Mirzapur - The Movie is set to hit the screens next month, bringing back beloved characters from the first season.

Adding to this, Pankaj Tripathi will reprise his role as Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur. Ahead of the movie’s grand trailer launch this week, star Pankaj Tripathi opened up on what new audiences can expect from the movie adaptation and his own first take on the movie.

Meanwhile, Mirzapur is set in the eponymous town in UP and deals with the clash between the family of local gangster Akhandanand Tripathi aka Kaleen Bhaiya (Pankaj Tripathi) and the Pandit brothers (Ali Fazal and Jitendra Kumar). The movie adaptation is seen as an origin story of how the clash began, a more elaborate version of what was shown in the first season of the show. However, Pankaj says there is a lot of newness in the movie.

Notably, When asked about what is new in Mirzapur that differentiates it from the show, the star says, “The new thing about the movie—and you actually touched upon this in your question—is the scale. On OTT, you watch on screens ranging from 5 to 100 inches, but now you’ll be watching on a 25-to-28-foot screen. So, the major shift is that you get to see it on the big screen and experience it communally. Until now, watching on OTT was a solitary, private affair; now, you’ll be watching it with an audience.”

As per the latest buzz, The two-time National Award-winning star says that the experience of communal watching will change how people see Mirzapur. “Whenever a performance or art form is experienced communally, the impact changes entirely. Enjoying it in a group creates a unique, shared experience. So, while Mirzapur used to be a "leave me alone” kind of watch, it’s now in "party mode.” The world is the same, the characters are the same, but the story is new, and the experience is much grander,” he says.

In further updates, The star reveals that he has been finishing the dubbing for the movie and is excited by how it has turned out. “I was doing some dubbing work yesterday and really enjoyed what I saw. I even wondered, ‘Is it just because I’m part of the movie that I’m enjoying it so much?’ So, I asked the makers, they’ve been with the project for ten months, whereas I was coming in to dub for the first time. Seeing it myself really ramped up my excitement; I can't wait for the trailer to drop on the 11th,” he adds.

On top of that, Presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment, Mirzapur: The Movie is directed by Gurmeet Singh, written by Puneet Krishna, and produced by Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar under the banner of Excel Entertainment. The movie is co-produced by Kassim Jagmagia and Vishal Ramchandani. Mirzapur is set for a theatrical rollout in Hindi and Telugu on 4 September 2026.

The movie stars Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi and Divyenndu, while Jitendra Kumar takes over from Vikrant Massey, who played Bablu in the show. Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Mohitt Maalik, Sheeba Chadha, Rajesh Tailang, Pramod Pathak, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Harshita Shekhar Gaur, Shweta Tripathi, and Sonal S Chauhan round off the cast.

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

EXCLUSIVE: After the news that Samara Weaving was in line for the Emma Frost role in the soon-to-release X-Men movie, it now looks like Marvel Studios has found its Scott Summers. Sources tell Deadline that Kit Connor is the choice for the mutant Cyclops .

Adding to this, Similar to the Weaving situation, where director Jake Schreier and Marvel president Kevin Feige met with a number of candidates, sources say the studio ultimately landed on Connor last week to become the latest star to don the Cyclops visor.
Meanwhile, Marvel and reps for Connor could not be reached for comment on the casting. Watch on Deadline

Notably, While James Bond has had everyone's attention this summer, the most active casting process has been who will play the new team of Mutants. Following meetings and auditions over the last couple months, sources say a small group of actors tested after the July 4 holiday.

As per the latest buzz, Summers has been one of the cornerstones of the X-Men comics, first appearing in a 1963 The X-Men from Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. The character has always been seen as the captain of the team of Mutants, best known for the powerful beams of energy emitted from his eyes that he controls through a visor and various sunglasses.

In further updates, The character has been played by two actors in the past: James Marsden, who portrayed him in three X-Men films in the 2000s, and Tye Sheridan, who played him in multiple X-Men films in the 2010s. (Marsden is already verified to reprise the role in the soon-to-release Avengers: Doomsday pic bowing in December.)

On top of that, This latest development is sure to excite followers of the franchise, who have been begging for a new X-Men movie since Disney's acquisition of 20th Century Fox and its library in 2019. The X-Men universe was by far the most popular and profitable Marvel IP that Fox controlled, spawning seven films and a successful Wolverine spinoff franchise that produced three more.

title: 8th pay commission: Fitment factor, DA merger — How much salary hike can be estimated?
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

More than 1 crore rupees beneficiaries are looking forward to DA hike, increase in fitment factor and salaries. ( File Photo ) AI Quick Read The 8th central pay commission (CPC) is in its consultation stage, having closed submission for suggestions and data from employee representative groups, unions and other stakeholders as of July.

Adding to this, It sought inputs from labour representatives and groups, ministries, pension bodies, central government organisations / institutions, employee unions / associations, and other similar stakeholders. This data will be analysed and then used to decide pay, allowances, pension, and salary for central government employees and pensioners.

Meanwhile, Earlier this month, the panel posted a number of notices on its website regarding official state visits and stakeholder meetings across India in August and September. As per the notices, meetings have been set up in Delhi, Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Puducherry (Union Territory), Chandigarh (UT, Haryana, Punjab and Himachal Pradesh), Jaipur (Rajasthan) and Mumbai (Indian Railways).

Notably, These unions and groups collectively represent a large number of employees and pensioners, including defence and railway staff. And the meetings are significant as discussions with representatives are expected to play an important role in shaping the commission's deliberations.

As per the latest buzz, Constituted every 10 years, the latest panel is expected to announce its decisions by mid-2027. Over 1 crore rupees beneficiaries — including around 50 lakh employees and about 65 lakh pensioners are looking forward to a hike in dearness allowance (DA), dearness relief (DR) and fitment factor.

In further updates, Overall salary increase under the 8th CPC will depend on the minimum pay, fitment factor and DA hike . At present, the likely increase is purely speculative as based on estimates by stakeholders and representatives.
On top of that, Notably, the commission is also expected to announce revised basic pay, and effective DA on the component, which may affect the final salary hike.

DA is important as it helps address inflationary concerns for burdened middle-class households, lower-income groups, and common salaried individuals. Groups have demanded the Centre announce DA merger based on 7th CPC recommendations. The issue has gained traction because basic salary determines calculation of the other components — provident fund contribution, pension, allowances, gratuity, etc. Thus, higher DA and, by association, basic pay mean an increase in overall salary and linked allowances.

The actors were on the show to promote their soon-to-release movie Batwara 1947 when Bachchan brought up an old birthday wish for Preity and pointed out that she had never responded to him.

title: ‘You didn’t look like a hero’: Govinda recalls blunt advice to Salman Khan during painful phase, urged him to exercise
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Star Govinda of late recalled a conversation with Salman Khan before they began shooting for their 2007 movie Partner, saying he advised the star to work on himself during a difficult phase and told him he would go on to "rule" the movie industry for a decade.

Adding to this, Salman Khan and Govinda in a still from Partner. 'Salman was going through a lot of pain' In conversation with ANI, Govinda shared Salman was dealing with "pain and distress" at the time and had become withdrawn. Govinda shared he decided to speak to him and encouraged him to look beyond his personal troubles.

Meanwhile, "Salman was going through a lot of pain and distress. And when someone is troubled by himself, whether it is because of love, hopes, or expectations, there is no one else who can really cure that. So, he had become very withdrawn. I thought I should introduce him to Satya, so we sat together and had a drink. While we were drinking, I told him, "Salman, you've looked outward enough. Now look within yourself," he told ANI.

Notably, "At that time, I weighed 114 kilos. It was the time when I had just come out of politics. I told him, "By the time I lose weight, I'll already be a character star, right? I'll continue doing the kind of roles I was doing in Partner, I was doing comedy." I told him, "You are the hero, but you don't look like one right now. You look unhappy, you look sad. Come out of this," he added

As per the latest buzz, According to Govinda, Salman then asked him what he should do. The Hero No. 1 star shared he advised Salman to exercise and reminded him of the qualities that made him stand out as a star.

In further updates, "He asked me, "What should I do?" I shared, "Exercise for two or three hours a day. Look at Dharmendra. You are the only hero, after Dharmendra, who has been blessed by God with parents, siblings, a good face and a great personality. You are the only guy who could carry that kind of aura, the kind that makes people look at you and say, 'That's a hero.'"

On top of that, Govinda shared Salman followed his advice and went on to enjoy a successful run in the years that followed. He also recalled telling Salman that he would rule the industry for a decade. "He did it. I told him, "You will rule for 10 years." And he did rule for 10 years."

'Partner,' directed by David Dhawan, starred Salman Khan and Govinda in the lead roles. Rolled out on July 20, 2007, the romantic comedy was a ticket-window success and the pairing of the two actors was well received by the audience. Songs including Do You Wanna Partner, Soni De Nakhre and You're My Love also became popular.

title: R Madhavan reacts to Dhurandhar being called propaganda: ‘Don’t understand how being Indian can be seen as wrong’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star R Madhavan of late addressed the criticism surrounding his films Dhurandhar (2025) and its sequel, Dhurandhar : The Revenge (2026), being called propaganda films by a certain section. The star clapped back at such claims and also questioned why it is wrong to be seen as Indian.

Adding to this, R Madhavan in a still from Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar. 'What does it mean by ‘being overly Indian’?' During an interaction with Galatta Plus, he spoke about how Dhurandhar was labelled “propaganda” and also spoke about his directorial debut, Rocketry: The Nambi Effect (2022), which many claimed emphasised being Indian. Responding to the same, he shared, “I don’t understand how being an Indian can be seen as a wrong thing. What does it mean by ‘being overly Indian’? I don’t know. Is it not okay to show myself as being ‘too Indian’? I don’t know. That’s not my conditioning; I showed that. This is not even a political statement. Dhurandhar was based in Pakistan. Good and bad things happen there as well, just as much as they do in India. So, I don’t understand what the ‘propaganda’ in it is."

Meanwhile, He added, “In Nambi sir’s (aerospace scientist Nambi Narayanan) case, I only showed what happened in his life. How can I be honest with the story if I am afraid to show who he really is? He is a person who goes to the temple. GD Naidu (inventor and engineer), on the other hand, is a nastik (atheist). So, we can’t show such things (him going to temples) in the movie. I have to be true to that character. Because of that, one can’t say that I don’t believe in god or vice versa. I am an star, and my job is to portray things as they are. My personal opinion is that I want to enhance all the good things about India. That cannot be a crime.”

Notably, Madhavan admitted that from a young age, he was taught that the country is the most important thing and that what we do for it is also very important. He shared that he hasn't spoken ill of any political party, politician or political leader in any of his interviews and has even lauded their achievements irrespective of the political party they belong to.

As per the latest buzz, He admitted that when he has doubts about something, he doesn't talk about it, and he believes that it is his duty to support an elected politician when they become a Prime Minister or a Chief Minister. The star also clarified that, to date, no party — be it in Tamil Nadu or at the national level — has approached him asking him to promote them or inviting him to join them.
In further updates, On the work front, Madhavan's G.D.N. is currently running in theatres. He has Adhirshtasaali and Circle in the pipeline.

title: Govinda recalls ‘kind of’ trying to end his life after mother's death: ‘Realised have to live for my children’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Govinda has opened up about the intense grief he experienced following the death of his mother, Nirmala Devi, revealing that he once entered the Narmada River believing he would "meet" her again.

Adding to this, Govinda recalled the painful memory of losing his mother. 'Felt everything was over' In a conversation with ANI, Govinda recalled being in "tremendous pain" after his mother's demise in 1996 and shared the loss left him feeling that everything was over.
Meanwhile, "I was in a lot of pain. I was in tremendous pain. At that point, I felt that everything was over; that was it," Govinda shared.

Notably, Nirmala Devi, a renowned Hindustani classical vocalist and star, died on June 15, 1996, at the age of 69. Govinda was extremely close to his mother and has often credited her spiritual influence with playing an important role in both his personal and professional life.

As per the latest buzz, Recalling the incident at the Narmada River, the star shared, "So, I was at the Narmada River, I thought I would go a little farther into the river and that I would meet my mother again. So, I went into the river."
In further updates, When asked whether he was trying to commit suicide, Govinda replied, "Kind of. I was deeply attached to my mother. I was too much in love with her."

On top of that, He later explained that he did not view the incident simply in those terms. "That's what the world calls it. People use suicide type of words. We don't really have anything like that. Life never ends. It takes on new faces; It takes on new forms," he shared.
Govinda recalled that a sadhu, whom he now reminisces as Ram Kundal, approached him and helped him come out of the river.

title: DA hike: How is dearness allowance for govt employees calculated? We explain the formula
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

DA for central government employees and pensioners is calculated using data from the AICPI index's 12-month average. ( Representative Image ) AI Quick Read Dearness Allowance (DA) is a percentage of the basic salary component for central government employees and pensioners which seeks to address rising cost-of-living. It is reviewed twice a year, new announcements are usually made annually in March and October, with rollouts in July the same year and January in the next year.

Adding to this, Over 1 crore rupees workers, comprising nearly 50 lakh central government employees and close to 65 lakh central government pensioners, including defence and railway personnel and retirees, benefit from the DA hikes and corresponding increase in Dearness Relief (DR).

Meanwhile, Notably, DA was last revised by 2% in April this year, taking it from 58% to 60% of basic salary, with effect from 1 January 2026. In the following months, the Indian Banks' Association ( IBA ) revealed revised DA and DR for workmen and officer employees across levels for the months of May, June and July 2026. And later, the Indian Railways also revealed a 2% DA and DR hike for its personnel.
Notably, Since then, multiple state governments have also increased DA and DR to close gaps in payment with the central government.

As per the latest buzz, DA hikes are calculated based using data from the 12-month average of the Labour Bureau's All India Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers ( AICPI -IW), as prescribed by the 7th central pay commission (CPC).

title: Govinda reveals why he stopped working with David Dhawan after 17 films: ‘Jis waqt use aisa laga ki…’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Govinda and filmmaker David Dhawan emerged as one of the hit star-director duos in the 1990s, delivering a string of memorable entertainers that continue to resonate with audiences. From Raja Babu, Coolie No 1 to Hero No 1 and Bade Miyan Chote Miyan , the duo's films became synonymous with comedy, catchy music, and Govinda's unmistakable comic timing.

Adding to this, Govinda reveals why he stopped working with David Dhawan. Govinda reveals why he stopped working with David Dhawan Years after their successful run together came to an end, Govinda has now opened up about why he stopped working with the filmmaker.
Meanwhile, In conversation with ANI, the star shared he believed David had simply reached a stage where he felt the partnership could no longer continue.

Notably, "We did 17 films together. David is like a God's child. Jis waqt use aisa laga ki samay aa gaya hai ki main Govinda ke saath aur aage nahi badh paunga, woh theher gaye (When he felt that the time had come when he could no longer move forward with Govinda, he stopped there). I wanted us to do an 18th and also a 19th movie together, but he didn't do it. So I felt that he was going according to his thinking. I never had any doubt about it," Govinda shared.

As per the latest buzz, The star also acknowledged that he would occasionally get upset with Dhawan, but maintained that their personal bond endured despite their professional association coming to an end.

In further updates, "Sometimes I used to get upset with him. I used to call him, and he would understand. Even now when my topic comes up, he starts crying. He is sincere. He is a good guy," Govinda shared.

On top of that, He also revealed reaching out to David Dhawan after the filmmaker's latest outing, recalling, "Abhi jab unki movie aane se pehle phone kiya tha. Mujhe laga unse mulaqat karni chahiye. Unhone rollout ke baad mujhe call kiya and kaha ki tu apni taklif se bahar nikal. (I called him before his movie's rollout as I felt like I should meet him. He called me after the rollout and told me to get over my troubles)."
Further in the conversation, Govinda also spoke about another collaborator from the most memorable phase of his career, the legendary Kader Khan.

title: Bhumi Pednekar braves flooded Assam roads to distribute solar lights: ‘Everywhere there is water’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bhumi Pednekar is doing her bit for those affected by the devastating Assam floods. The star has shared a video of herself travelling to flood-hit districts of the state to take part in relief efforts and provide aid to those affected by the floods. Bhumi travelled to the flood-hit state with the Bharat Disaster Relief Foundation (BDRF).

Adding to this, Bhumi Pednekar participates in relief effort in Assam. Bhumi takes part in relief effort Bhumi reshared a video by BDRF that shows her travelling in a car in the dark. She says, "The google map is showing that there is a road but everywhere there is water." She is seen distributing solar lights to those affected by the floods. She is also seen talking to Assam flood victims and handing them food and other relief item packets.

Meanwhile, The video shows that even at around 11pm, her surroundings are filled with water. She says in the video that the water level has not gone down for the last three weeks. She explains that this is why they have been distributing solar lights to families, so they can protect themselves from snakes and other reptiles during this time. "It is very difficult. You will have to come and eperience this to know the condition," she shared in the clip.

Notably, She captioned the post, "Doesn’t matter what time of the day, volunteers are there supporting people @bdrf_official. Distributed solar lights to flood-affected families who are struggling with limited access to electricity and safe lighting. For families living in temporary shelters, a light after sunset is more than just a necessity, it brings safety, comfort, and hope."
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bhumi Satish Pednekkar (@bhumisatishpednekkar)

In further updates, Earlier, Bhumi had shared videos of herself walking through knee-deep water to provide aid to those affected by the floods. In another video, Bhumi is seen arriving at a house surrounded by water in a boat. Not just Bhumi, Randeep Hooda had also participated in the relief effort. He joined on-the-ground relief efforts in Assam's Sivasagar district, actively working alongside the NGO Global Sikhs to serve hot meals (langar). Comedian Samay Raina had also donated ₹ 10 lakh to the CM Relief Fund to help those affected by floods in Assam.

On top of that, Earlier, Bhumi had criticised protesters at the CJP protest in Delhi for using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Her remarks prompted many on social media to question her choice to school the protesters while remaining silent on the student-led CJP protest in Delhi, which demanded education reforms following NEET paper leak.

title: Jude Anthany Joseph reveals he walked out of Ayushmann Khurrana film after producers called Mohanlal ‘secondary artist’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Malayalam filmmaker Jude Anthany Joseph of late opened up about leaving an Ayushmann Khurrana -starrer movie midway through discussions. Jude shared that he chose to walk out of the project after his demand to confirm Mohanlal's role in the movie was taken lightly. The Malayalam superstar was also referred to as a 'secondary artist' by the production house, a description Jude found insulting to 'one of the finest actors in the country.'

Adding to this, Jude Anthany Joseph was set to make a movie with Ayushmann Khurrana. Jude on quitting Ayushmann Khurrana movie While in conversation with Club FM, the Thudakkam director shared that he was approached by several production houses across movie industrues like Tamil, Telugu for his story, but he chose to develop it with Ayushmann Khurrana as he called the project ‘a proper Bollywood movie’. He shared he had also developed the basic script for the proposed Hindi movie before approaching the production house.

Meanwhile, He shared that Mohanlal had an important character in the story, but the production house wanted him to complete the screenplay before committing to any casting. “The basic script was almost complete. We had also discussed the story with the production house. At that time, Lal sir had a role in the story. It was an important role. However, they asked me to complete the screenplay first. At that point, I put forward a demand to them. I told them that I could complete the script, but my condition was that Lal sir should be verified for the project.”

Notably, However, their choice of words was what rubbed Jude the wrong way. He shared, “They responded by saying, ‘First, we need to like the script. Only then will we think about the secondary artists.’” Jude admitted that he was unhappy with Mohanlal being called a 'secondary artist' by the production house. This was the reason he decided to walk away from the project.

As per the latest buzz, Jude shared that he eventually brought his lawyer into the matter and withdrew from the project. In the end, he also opened up that he made the production house sign a non-disclosure agreement.

In further updates, Jude made his directorial debut with the critically acclaimed Ohm Shanthi Oshaana in 2014. He went on to direct films such as Oru Muthassi Gadha (2016) and Sara's (2021) and short movie No Go Tell. His movie, 2018, received positive reviews and was a massive hit, grossing around ₹ 200 crore rupees. His movie Thudakkam (2016) marked the acting debut of Mohanlal's daughter Vismaya Mohanlal.

title: Superstar's cousin became a 70s heartthrob after 2 hits, later vanished from Bollywood: Where is Tariq Khan now?
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

He was one of Bollywood’s most recognisable young stars of the 1970s, winning over audiences with his boyish charm, dancing skills and hit songs. After making a striking debut and following it up with another successful movie, he seemed destined for a long innings as a leading man. Yet, at the peak of his career, the star chose to step away from Bollywood and explore an entirely different path.

Adding to this, Aamir Khan's cousin Tariq Khan left Bollywood after not getting substantial work. Tariq Khan's Bollywood journey Tariq Khan comes from a family with deep roots in Hindi cinema. He is the son of Azhar Ali Khan, who was married to Anzie Khan, the sister of Nasir Hussain and Tahir Hussain, who produced several notable films. He is also the cousin of superstar Aamir Khan and filmmaker Mansoor Ali Khan , making him part of one of Bollywood’s best-known movie families.

Meanwhile, While Tariq’s father wanted him to become a doctor, the star was never too interested in academics. He was interested in films and, instead of directly giving him a break, his uncle Nasir Hussain insisted that he assist him in production. This marked the beginning of his journey in the movie industry. He assisted his uncle on Caravan and later, at a party, Nasir realised his talent after seeing him dance and decided to cast him in Yaadon Ki Baaraat alongside stars such as Dharmendra and Vijay Arora. The movie was written by Salim-Javed.

Notably, The 1973 movie turned out to be his major acting debut. Tariq was only 22 when the movie turned him into an overnight sensation. Looking back at the phase when he became a star, Tariq described it as an “euphoric” experience and credited Nasir Hussain with recognising his potential in a 2021 interview with HT.

As per the latest buzz, The movie gave him several memorable moments, particularly through the songs Yaadon Ki Baaraat, Aap Ke Kamre Mein and Lekar Hum Deewana Dil. Tariq lip-synced, played the guitar and danced in the songs, which went on to become hugely popular. He became the heartthrob of the 1970s and was known as the “rockstar” and “the guitar boy”. Interestingly, his cousin Aamir Khan also appeared in the movie as the younger version of Tariq’s character, Monto.

In further updates, If Yaadon Ki Baaraat introduced Tariq as Bollywood’s new young heartthrob, Hum Kisise Kum Naheen cemented his popularity. The 1977 musical, also directed by Nasir Hussain, became a major success and gave Tariq another strong lead role at a time when his career was gathering momentum. It further established Tariq as one of the promising young stars of the era. However, his journey in Bollywood did not turn out as expected.

On top of that, He went on to play a negative role in the movie Zamaane Ko Dikhana Hai, where he played Kader Khan’s son. The movie also featured stars such as Rishi Kapoor, Padmini Kolhapure and Amjad Khan, but still failed to make a mark and flopped at the ticket-window. After this, Tariq’s career went downhill. He featured in films such as Shaukeen and Pasand Apni Apni with Ashok Kumar, Manzil Manzil with Sunny Deol and Baat Ban Jaye with Sanjeev Kumar, but all of these were supporting roles.

His last movie, Mera Damad, was rolled out in 1995, after which he quit Bollywood. He admitted that taking up a role in Zamaane Ko Dikhana Hai might have been a mistake. At the same time, he opened up that he had signed several films as a leading man, but many of those projects never made it to completion. For an star trying to establish himself, unfinished films meant that the momentum he had built could not always translate into a sustained career.

title: Director Shakeel Noorani arrested in alleged rape case; actor accuses him of drugging her, threatening with video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Director Shakeel Noorani, 73, who is known for producing and directing films such as Bade Dil Wala (1999) and Joru Ka Ghulam (2000), was arrested by the Malvani Police in the early hours of August 8 before being brought to Mumbai in connection with an alleged rape and sexual assault case filed by a 33-year-old female star.

Adding to this, Director Shakeel Noorani arrested in alleged rape case of star. What is the case? According to a report in Mid-day, the director is accused of calling a woman to his Malvani residence on the pretext of discussing an soon-to-release movie project and sexually assaulting her. He is also accused of administering a sedative and threatening the woman with an alleged video. Police sources told the website that the director was traced to a farmhouse in Medha, Satara district, and arrested.

Meanwhile, The Malvani Police have registered a case under Sections 64(2)(M), 123, 351(2) and 88 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Police have sought his custody to further investigate the case and ascertain whether the alleged offences took place at other locations. The Borivali holiday court “remanded Noorani in police custody till August 12”.

Notably, The report states that the star first met the director in 2016 at an award show in Lokhandwala. During their interaction at the award show, he allegedly asked her to contact him for work regarding an soon-to-release project.

As per the latest buzz, In the FIR, she alleged that the director gave her a drink, after which she fell unconscious when she later visited his Malvani residence to read a script. She further alleged that Noorani threatened to circulate a video that he had recorded and warned her not to approach the police or inform her family. She accused him of using the video as a tool to threaten her further and sexually assault her repeatedly and on multiple occasions.

In further updates, As per the report, she also alleged that Noorani repeatedly gave her contraceptive pills following the alleged sexual encounters. The report states that the woman returned to Mumbai in 2026 while seeking financial assistance for medical treatment.

On top of that, Shakeel's advocate Vikas Singh Goar has maintained that his client has been falsely implicated. “The allegations made by the star are yet to be established before a court, and the investigation is underway. Noorani is presumed innocent unless proven guilty,” he shared.

title: Exclusive | Ravi Kishan on viral meme fest: Gen Z has accepted me as their own, it's their love and Mahadev's blessing
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ravi Kishan may not have set out to become the internet’s latest obsession, but social media had other plans. The star and Lok Sabha member has lately found himself at the centre of a meme frenzy, with his expressions, dance moves and distinctive dialogue delivery on podcasts and interviews becoming fodder for countless widely shared posts.

Adding to this, Star Ravi Kishan and his widely shared memes From ‘Pehchaan or Paisa? Paisaan! Money follows… my braatheer’ and ‘Hmmmmmm… better do it!’ to ‘Jaldi, the late!’, Kishan’s every move seems to be finding a new audience online.
Meanwhile, We caught up with Kishan, who, in his inimitable style, sums up the phenomenon simply: “I don’t do it… it happens, brother!”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

As per the latest buzz, He shares, “Yeh kuch alag hi khel chal raha hai, yeh pagalpan hai! Shravan month is on and when Mahadev showers his blessings, this happens. It has never happened before for anyone – star or politician – in this country. Pagalpan hai! People speak anything to become popular and my maun vrat became even more popular.”

In further updates, For Kishan, perhaps the most surprising part is that none of this was planned. “The best part is that this is happening organically. Even the BJP handle, Delhi Police and Maharashtra Government have made memes. I am personally following it all and dropping a ‘like’ as well,” he says.

The 57-year-old credits Gen Z for it all: “No one has discovered me before. Now, they want to see me more and know me more. Gen Z has accepted me as their own. I really want to thank them and salute their creativity.”

title: Jimmy Shergill reflects on Satluj row, recalls Maachis' success despite similar theme: ‘Politics exists’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Jimmy Shergill says films attempting to portray politically sensitive periods of history often run into trouble as they bring out hidden truths, and things naturally become complicated and political.

Adding to this, Jimmy Shergill reacts to Satluj row, Jimmy Shergill on Satluj row The star responded to a query on why a movie like Satluj , which dealt with a sensitive subject, did not see a rollout while his own debut, Maachis, dealing with a similar theme was appreciated.
Meanwhile, Satluj starring star-singer Diljit Dosanjh rolled out in India last month on streaming service ZEE5 but became unavailable on the platform just two days later in India.

Notably, The movie, based on the life of human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, was stuck in censorship for over three years and was given over 127 cuts by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC).

As per the latest buzz, "Politics exists, and it will always go on. But it is good when such issues are stirred up because it brings every single aspect out into the open. When you touch upon even a single aspect of sensitive matters, other hidden aspects surface as well. So, that is the politics of it," Shergill told PTI in an interview.

In further updates, On the other side, Maachis, which was directed by Gulzar, was set against the turbulent period of insurgency in Punjab during the 1980s. Also starring Chandrachur Singh, Om Puri, and Tabu, the political thriller explores the personal and political turmoil faced by people caught in violence.

On top of that, Upon the rollout, Maachis received critical acclaim and was a commercial hit too. At the 44th National Movie Awards, the movie won two honours, including Best Popular Movie Providing Wholesome Entertainment and Best Star award for Tabu.
Shergill, who made his acting debut with Maachis, shared he was largely guided by the filmmaker's vision.

Adding to this, For more than a year, Sadie Sink had to keep her role in "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" a secret. Sink, who was offered the part after her breakout performances in " Stranger Things " and "The Whale," showed up to the London set without having read a full script . For security, her character was referred to with a code name.

Meanwhile, When it came time to promote the movie this summer, the trailers hadn't revealed more than the fact that Sink's character is a hooded figure with questionable intentions — and the ability to jump into anyone's mind. So, even as Sink showed up for photo calls with her co-stars Tom Holland and Zendaya and partook in interviews, she had to find creative ways to talk around what she'd done on set.

Notably, As obvious as it might've been to the Marvel faithful that Sink was playing Jean Grey, the Omega-level mutant who will go on to star in the studio's soon-to-release " X-Men " movie, Sink wasn't going to be the one who spoiled it.
As per the latest buzz, And she didn't. Steve Lacy did — right at the finish line.

In further updates, At the movie's world premiere in Los Angeles, the R&B singer, who has a song on the "Brand New Day" soundtrack, opened up that his favorite character from the movie was the villain, "Jean," during the official red carpet live stream. "She's the villain but, like, there's a reason to her madness," he shared.

On top of that, What did Sink make of that moment? "Honestly, it was amazing!" Sink tells Variety , laughing. "I was like, ‘Ah!' He kind of set me free in a lot of ways. And I’m such a big fan of his."

To be fair, Sink had already told a few trusted people the truth, including her "Stranger Things" bosses, Matt and Ross Duffer. But now that the movie is in theaters ( supplanting "Avengers: Endgame" as the biggest domestic debut in ticket-window history and grossing $1.15 billion worldwide in just seven days) and Sink's secret identity is revealed, she's finally gotten the green light to discuss her experience as the third star to play the role after Famke Janssen in Fox's "X-Men" movies and Sophie Turner in the 2010s reboot movies.

title: Monsoon to unleash intense rain over these regions in India, forecasts show
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Accumulated rainfall forecasts from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), show substantial rain building up over Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, parts of Maharashtra and adjoining areas between roughly August 8-15. Vehicles wade through a waterlogged road following heavy rainfal. (Photo: PTI)
Adding to this, Some pockets could record accumulated rainfall of more than 100-200 mm, while isolated higher totals are possible over parts of the Northeast.

Meanwhile, The developing wet spell comes even as the India Meteorological Department ( IMD ) has indicated that the monsoon season could end below normal, with seasonal rainfall projected at around 90% of the long-period average.
Notably, Developing El Nino conditions in the Pacific are among the factors influencing the broader seasonal outlook.
As per the latest buzz, ECMWF's ensemble and deterministic forecasts currently show the monsoon trough and associated low-pressure systems supporting a stronger flow of moisture into Central India.
In further updates, The core monsoon zone is likely to see widespread moderate to heavy rain, while northern and northeastern parts of the country could see more scattered but significant rainfall.

On top of that, Recent IMD bulletins have already reported heavy to very heavy rain at isolated places over East Rajasthan, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and neighbouring areas, pointing to an active phase. Commuters make their way amid heavy rain. (Photo: PTI) WHY DOES AN ACTIVE SPELL MATTER?
Even if the seasonal rainfall total remains below normal, individual bursts of heavy rain can have a major impact.

title: Characters have lost their distinct identity in Hindi cinema: Actor Akhilendra Mishra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Lucknow, Veteran star Akhilendra Mishra says the enduring popularity of memorable characters in Hindi cinema and television has faded because today's films are no longer creating distinct personalities on screen, with most roles beginning to resemble one another.

Adding to this, Characters have lost their distinct identity in Hindi cinema: Star Akhilendra Mishra In conversation with PTI during a visit here, the star, known for roles such as Kroor Singh in "Chandrakanta", Mirchi Seth in "Sarfarosh", DSP Bhurelal in "Gangajal", shared strong characterisation, rather than screen time, was what once made supporting roles live on in public memory.
Meanwhile, Mishra also essayed the role of Arjan in the Aamir Khan-starrer Oscar-nominated "Lagaan", which is celebrated 25th anniversary this year.

Notably, "Earlier, people connected with characters. Today, films lack characterisation. Everyone acts in a similar way and speaks in the same tone. In the process, the colour and identity of characters have disappeared. When audiences cannot relate to a character, films eventually suffer," Mishra shared.
As per the latest buzz, Drawing an analogy, he shared audiences respond to diversity in storytelling just as they marvel at a rainbow rather than plain white light.

In further updates, "When you see a rainbow, you call others to look at it because all seven colours are visible. Similarly, stories, performances, music, emotions and presentation need different shades. Today, we are only seeing white light.

On top of that, "They searched for actors who could become those characters. I was chosen for Kroor Singh because of my theatre work. John Matthew Matthan picked me for 'Sarfarosh' after watching one of my plays," he recalled.
The star, however, acknowledged the industry's working culture has become more organised.

title: Redmi Note 17 5G vs Vivo S2: Best Mid-Rangers Compared
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Xiaomi powers Redmi Note 17 5G with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 processor.
Adding to this, Vivo S2 offers a 3D curved AMOLED display with 1.5K high-resolution video visuals.
Meanwhile, Both mid-range smartphones feature 120Hz smooth refresh rate screens for Indian consumers today.

Notably, Xiaomi’s Redmi Note 17 5G went official as the successor to the Redmi Note 15 5G, built almost entirely around the promise of all-day battery life. A short while later, Vivo brought its S-series back to India after a seven-year gap with the Vivo S2 , a phone built around design, cameras, and content creation for younger buyers. Both target the same price band and the same first-time upgrader, but they are chasing different priorities, which makes a direct comparison useful for anyone deciding between the two.

As per the latest buzz, The Redmi Note 17 5G’s headline feature is its 8,000mAh battery, marketed under the “mAhster Edition” branding as one of the largest capacities seen in a mainstream mid-range phone. Xiaomi is positioning it squarely at users who travel often, game for long stretches, or simply cannot charge regularly through the day.

In further updates, The Vivo S2, by contrast, is tipped to carry a 7,050mAh battery, which is still a generous capacity and comfortably ahead of most phones in this segment, but roughly 950mAh short of the Redmi. On paper, this makes the Redmi Note 17 5G the stronger pick for buyers who rank battery endurance above everything else, though Vivo’s number remains unconfirmed until the official launch.

On top of that, Both phones use 120Hz AMOLED panels, so refresh rate and panel technology are effectively tied. The difference lies in shape and size. The Redmi Note 17 5G sticks with a flat-frame AMOLED display protected by Corning Gorilla Glass 7i, prioritizing durability and a familiar in-hand feel.

The Vivo S2 goes with a larger 6.83-inch 3D curved AMOLED screen, as per reports at 1.5K resolution, which should give it a more premium, immersive look and feel in daily use, even if curved glass is traditionally a little more prone to accidental drops than a flat panel. Buyers who care about a flagship-like visual experience may lean toward the Vivo, while those who prioritize ruggedness will likely prefer the Redmi’s flatter, Gorilla Glass-backed design.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Ahaan Panday ’s sister and social media influencer Alanna Panday is expecting her second child with her husband, Ivor McCray. Alanna took to social media to announce the news, and her cousin Ananya Panday was quick to shower her with love.

Adding to this, Alanna Panday revealed second pregnancy. Alanna Panday announces second pregnancy On Saturday, Alanna posted on Instagram and shared a dreamy video of herself wearing a halter-neck dress and walking through a garden with her son, River, with a castle in the background. She was later joined by her husband, who held their son, River, in his arms. Alanna then flaunted her baby bump and gently caressed it. River gave his mother a sweet hug, seemingly unaware that he would soon become a big brother. Ivor was also seen affectionately caressing Alanna’s baby bump. The couple also shared a photo of the sonography with the caption, ‘coming soon’. Alanna captioned the video, "one more to love."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Alanna Panday (@alannapanday)

Notably, Her mother, Deanne Panday, expressed her happiness over Alanna’s second pregnancy and wrote, "Grandmaa for the second time. God bless you." Alizeh Agnihotri, Mrunal Thakur and Aliyah Kashyap also congratulated the couple. Ivor commented, "River upgraded to big bro." Ananya Panday re-shared the video on her Instagram Story and added multiple red heart emojis and an evil eye emoji to express her happiness.

As per the latest buzz, Alanna is the daughter of Chunky Panday’s brother, Chikki Panday, and fitness instructor Deanne Panday. She is a social media influencer who made her screen debut with the Karan Johar-backed show The Tribe. Rolled out on Prime Video in 2024, the show also featured Alfia Jafry, Aryaana Gandhi, Srushti Porey and Alaviaa Jaaferi.

In further updates, Alanna married her long-time boyfriend, Ivor, in a Hindu wedding ceremony in Mumbai in March 2023. On top of that, The couple welcomed their son, River, in 2024. Talking about embracing parenthood, Alanna shared in one of her videos, "It has truly been amazing. I don’t think anything can prepare you for the change your life is going to go through. I think you grow so much as a person when you start a family; there is so much more responsibility, and you learn a lot about yourself and what you’re capable of. body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Raha may be one of Bollywood’s youngest star kids, but according to her grandfather Mahesh Bhatt , she has already become the centre of attention at home. The filmmaker of late opened up about his granddaughter’s lively personality, saying her energy takes over the entire household and predicting that she could one day “outdistance” her famous parents, Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt .

Adding to this, Mahesh Bhatt says Raha will outdistance her parents. Mahesh Bhatt talks about granddaughter Raha Talking about Raha in an interview with Times of India, Mahesh spoke about how her energy captivates everyone and shared, “She'll outdistance Ranbir Kapoor and Alia by miles. She's different. She has a different vibe. When she comes, the whole house becomes hostage to her energy. For those few hours, she becomes the centre of everything.”

Meanwhile, He added that Raha reminds him of a younger Pooja Bhatt and shared, “I of late went with Neetu (Kapoor) to her school for her Grandparents' Day. Soni was in Istanbul. We were walking through a cloud of soap bubbles. I was holding Raha's hand while Neetu was holding the other. It was a beautiful moment. That was something which I remember doing with only Pooja. It brought back memories of walking with Pooja when she was little. Suddenly, time collapsed. She is a vibrant version of Pooja. (Eventually) The same kind of family.”

Notably, Ranbir and Alia tied the knot in an intimate wedding ceremony at their residence in 2022, with only close friends and family in attendance. The same year, the couple welcomed their daughter, Raha. When Raha turned one, Ranbir and Alia introduced her to the world. As per the latest buzz, Alia and Ranbir have often spoken about how Raha has changed them. In a podcast with Jay Shetty, Alia spoke about Ranbir and Raha’s bond and shared, "When he looks at Raha, there are stars in his eyes. Of course, (that’s true) for any parents. But when I see it, because I’ve known Ranbir before and I know him now, I see the difference. I see the difference in the way he is with people, you know, as a father. He’s just so sort of full. It’s not like he was ever edgy. He always had a very calm demeanour, but there’s a fullness which I experienced first-hand and that I see on a daily basis, and it’s actually really sweet and special to watch their conversations."
